title: wg: ext-10 §5 no enforcement rule for required safe_aad list
description: Suggestion. draft-ietf-mls-extensions-10 §5 (L885-911): the safe_aad component in a LeafNode is 'the list of supported components that use Safe AAD'; in the GroupContext it is 'the list of required Safe AAD components (those that must be understood by the entire group)'. 'must' is lowercase, §4.6 (L585-588) requires only understanding safe_aad, not advertising it, and nothing at the level of RFC 9420 §11.1 (required_capabilities) says what a committer does when a joining or updating leaf's safe_aad list does not cover the GroupContext list, or omits it. The same gap applies to app_components. Implementations will diverge: some reject such Adds, others accept and the new member cannot parse authenticated_data. Found re-checking mimid decision mimid-1wgh.4.35 (bug mimid-1wgh.4.44). Fix: a normative rule mirroring §11.1 (MUST reject leaves that do not list every required component; absent list = empty), or state that the requirement is not enforced.
notes: Editor's-copy check 2026-10-17: mlswg/mls-extensions#102 (open) covers enforcement; add our evidence there rather than a new issue.
